# @rankingcoach/vanguard

> rankingCoach React component library (React 19). This file and docs/components/*.md ship inside the package, so they always match the installed version (see ../package.json).

## Imports

- Everything public is a named export of the root: `import { Button, Text } from '@rankingcoach/vanguard';`. Load the stylesheet once: `import '@rankingcoach/vanguard/style.css';`.
- WordPress hosts use the single bundle in `dist-wordpress/` (its export list is a curated subset; each component page says "WordPress bundle: yes/no").
- Deep paths that must keep working: `@rankingcoach/vanguard/dist/*` (e.g. `dist/index-OverlayStackingService.js`). Do not import other internal paths.

## Stylesheet order (consumers get this wrong)

Vanguard's CSS decides equal-specificity ties by position. Keep the head order: 1. the app's entry-chunk CSS, 2. `@rankingcoach/vanguard/style.css`, 3. route-chunk (lazy) CSS. Load the Vanguard stylesheet after the entry CSS and before any route chunk (e.g. a dynamic `import('@rankingcoach/vanguard/style.css')` right after the first render). Moving it into a route chunk or bundling it ahead of the app's entry CSS flips which rules win.

## DOM contract: data-slot is the contract, Mui* classes are an alias

- Rebuilt components mark their parts with `data-slot="<component>"` / `data-slot="<component>-<part>"` (kebab-case) and expose state as attributes on the same element: booleans present-empty or absent (`data-disabled`, `data-selected`, `data-open`, `data-pressed`, `data-checked`, `data-loading`, ...), enums as values (`data-size`, `data-variant`, `data-type`, `data-orientation`). Style and test against these: `[data-slot="switch"][data-checked]`.
- `Mui*` class names still present on some elements are a compatibility alias kept during the rebuild; they will go away. Never introduce new selectors on them.
- Components whose page says "Internals pending rebuild" still render MUI internally and have no final slots yet.

## Forms

- New forms: `const form = useFormStore<Values>({ initialValues, inputs, action })`, render `<Form config={form.formConfig} action={form.formAction}>` and bind inputs by name with `field="email"` (any depth, no prop drilling; `index` for array fields). The action receives typed values; read pending with React's `useFormStatus()` in a child of the form; `form.result` holds the action's result. No Redux store or Provider needed.
- Legacy (supported, do not use for new code): `useFormConfig` + a Redux slice, inputs receive `formconfig={...}`. Existing forms keep working unchanged.

## Components, hooks and helpers

### Components

- [AcceptModal](components/AcceptModal.md): Standard accept confirmation modal with primary/secondary actions.
- [Accordion](components/Accordion.md) (WordPress): Collapsible panel component for hiding and revealing content sections with animation.
- [ActionBar](components/ActionBar.md): Container for primary actions and controls, often fixed at the bottom/top of a view.
- [ActionButton](components/ActionButton.md): Button component optimized for action calls, supports icons and variants.
- [ActionCard](components/ActionCard.md): Card component that groups primary content with actionable controls and metadata.
- [ActionCardAction](components/ActionCardAction.md): Action component used inside `ActionCard` for inline controls like buttons or links.
- [ActionCardActions](components/ActionCardActions.md): Container for action controls in `ActionCard` (primary/secondary actions).
- [ActionCardBody](components/ActionCardBody.md): Main content area of an `ActionCard` used to render title, description and content.
- [ActionCardHeader](components/ActionCardHeader.md): Header section for `ActionCard` that contains title, subtitle and optional controls.
- [ActionCardInfo](components/ActionCardInfo.md): Supplementary information block for `ActionCard` used to display metadata like timestamps or statuses.
- [AdvancedMarkerF](components/AdvancedMarkerF.md)
- [AIAssistant](components/AIAssistant.md): Interactive AI assistant UI component for suggestions, prompts and conversational tasks.
- [AIBudgetEnd](components/AIBudgetEnd.md): UI component that notifies users when their AI budget or credits have been exhausted.
- [AiGlow](components/AiGlow.md): Visual glow effect component used to indicate AI processing or emphasis around elements.
- [AIOrb](components/AIOrb.md) (WordPress): Small indicator showing AI status and activity with size and status variants.
- [Alert](components/Alert.md): Alert component for displaying prominent messages (success, warning, error, info) with optional actions.
- [AnimatedConditional](components/AnimatedConditional.md): Utility that renders children with conditional animations based on state changes.
- [AnimatedNumber](components/AnimatedNumber.md)
- [AnimatedSwitchConditional](components/AnimatedSwitchConditional.md): Helper that toggles between two states with an animated transition when a condition changes.

- [ArcGauge](components/ArcGauge.md): Visual arc gauge used to represent progress, percentages or single-value metrics.
- [AreaChart](components/AreaChart.md): Area chart for visualizing time-series or stacked area datasets with axes and legends.
- [AssetPreloader](components/AssetPreloader.md): Preloads images, fonts and other assets to improve perceived performance and avoid layout shifts.
- [Autocomplete](components/Autocomplete.md) (WordPress): Input with suggestion dropdown supporting keyboard navigation and async sources.
